scripts.lint:something: bash -c '[[ "${NODE_OPTIONS:-}" == *"--permissions"* ]] && echo PASS-lint:something-permissions || { echo FAIL-lint:something-empty; exit 1; }'
scripts.lint:somethingelse: bash -c '[[ "${NODE_OPTIONS:-}" == *"--permissions"* ]] && echo PASS-lint:somethingelse-permissions || { echo FAIL-lint:somethingelse-empty; exit 1; }'
scripts.test: npm run lint:something && npm run lint:somethingelse && npm run lint:directmatch
